kind: re-run to obtain class-A evidence after the runner loss
why_this_rerun_exists: The EXP-05 class-A artifacts (session logs, candidate library, post-quit captures) were lost with the Windows runner before they were pushed. The published EXP-05 section is a class-C reconstruction from the conversation record. This run regenerates first-hand evidence.

baseline.how_built: iTunes itself built it: first launch against an empty library directory, then one COM AddFile of a synthetic 440 Hz tone, then a normal COM Quit. Baseline construction is not an acceptance result and is not counted as one.

this_is_a_different_lineage_than_the_los.consequence: No byte, size or digest from the lost run may be reused as a control for this run.

candidate.relaxation_disclosed_up_front: operation_version_spoofed(): the container version is reported as 12.13.10.3 for the whole operation, not only at the entry gate, because trackops.set_indexed_fields -> Track.set -> library._require_semantic_profile reads the version a second time after the gate. This is strictly wider than the EXP-03 and EXP-04 relaxation, so a pass licenses less, not more.
candidate.still_enforced_by_real_itlkit_code: identity and reference checks, the 144-byte header rule, the trailer rule, the section allowlist, the empty-grandchild rule, the store index shape and the metadata child codes
candidate.product_code_unchanged: the relaxation lives in a research script outside itlkit/; itlkit's accepted-version set is not widened

protocol: declare: this file, committed and pushed before the candidate is built
import: replace the library .itl with the candidate
launch and let iTunes read and save
restart 1 against the file iTunes wrote
restart 2 against the file iTunes wrote
acceptance_requires_all_of: no corruption modal in any of the three sessions
no 'iTunes Library (Damaged).itl' and no fallback library created
the library directory keeps exactly its 4 files in every session
COM reports version 12.13.11.1 in every session
COM reports library_track_count=1 and playlist_count=7 in every session
COM reports the edited name, artist and album in all three sessions
a normal COM Quit in all three sessions
explicitly_not_acceptance: byte equality of the post-quit .itl, because iTunes' rewrite is not byte-deterministic
structural validity of the candidate on its own
audible playback, which is not attempted here
prediction: Accepted. The lost run reported acceptance under the same relaxation on a different lineage, so a refusal here would mean the earlier report depended on something about that lineage. Recorded so it can be wrong on the record.
revocation_rule: If any session shows a corruption modal, a renamed or regenerated library, a changed file count, or a missing edit, the acceptance claim is withdrawn. This file is not rewritten afterwards.
